title: Mind over Math: AI-Assisted Resilient Learning Chatbot for Teaching Mathematics
content: Mathematics anxiety is one of the widely recognized psychological challenges that negatively impact students’ ability to learn, participate in, and perform mathematical tasks. This research introduces the development, deployment, and assessment of a customized AI-driven learning companion designed to alleviate math-related anxiety and boost confidence in mathematics among high school learners. The foundation of the solution lies in the Resilient Learning Method, an educational strategy that emphasizes emotional safety, confidence-building, and progressive learning to establish a responsive and encouraging environment. The AI Assistant operationalizes these Resilient Learning strategies through carefully designed interaction flows that specifically target anxiety reduction. The system was evaluated with 50 high school students using pre- and post-intervention surveys, demonstrating the effectiveness of the Resilient Learning methodology for anxiety reduction with 86% of participants reporting decreased mathematics anxiety, alongside improvements in confidence levels from 66% to 86%. This research contributes to mathematics education by providing the first successful implementation of AI-delivered Resilient Learning methodology that effectively addresses mathematics anxiety while improving learning outcomes.
